registration.title: A different blend of current and long-term club rank near kickoff
registration.what: Weights other than 60% current rank and 40% long-term rank for a match played today.
registration.why: The 60/40 blend had been chosen in an earlier backtest and had not been checked against its neighbours on held-out matches.
registration.how: The rank going into each match is rebuilt with weights of 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8 and 1.0; 2023/24 chooses, and July 2024 onwards is scored.
registration.hypothesis: Some weight other than 0.6 gives better result predictions.
registration.success_criteria: The standing bar: result log loss better by at least 0.002 on held-out matches, with the interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing and the same direction in each season.

events.label: Best alternative (0.7) against 0.6, July 2024 onwards
events.meaningful: No. Validation and test both choose 0.6. The interval for 0.7 runs from better by 0.0001 to worse by 0.0003.

events.reason: The production value is itself the validated best. Keep 0.6 / 0.4.
